title: The web server must disable accounts when the accounts have expired.
check_content:
Verify the web server is configured to disable accounts when the accounts have expired.

If the web server is not configured to disable accounts when the accounts have expired, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the web server to disable accounts when the accounts have expired.
VulnDiscussion: Disabling expired, inactive, or otherwise anomalous accounts supports the concepts of least privilege and least functionality which reduce the attack surface of the system.
